title.zh: 卷三百八十六 列傳第一百四十五 劉珙 王藺 黃祖舜 王大寶 金安節 王剛中 李彥穎 范成大
title.en: Volume 386 Biographies 145: Liu Gong, Wang Lin, Huang ZuShun, Wang Dabao, Jin Anjie, Wang Gangzhong, Li Yanying, Fan Chengda
title.raw: 卷三百八十六 列傳第一百四十五 劉珙 王藺 黃祖舜 王大寶 金安節 王剛中 李彥穎 范成大 Volume 386 Biographies 145: Liu Gong, Wang Lin, Huang ZuShun, Wang Dabao, Jin Anjie, Wang Gangzhong, Li Yanying, Fan Chengda

sentences.zh: 劉珙，字共父，子羽長子也。

translations.literal: Liu Gong, styled Gongfu, was the eldest son of Ziyu.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Gong, courtesy name Gongfu, was the eldest son of Liu Ziyu.

sentences.zh: 生有奇質，從季父子翬學。

translations.literal: Born with extraordinary qualities, he studied under his father's younger brother Zihui.
translations.idiomatic: He showed exceptional gifts from birth and studied under his uncle Liu Zihui.

sentences.zh: 以蔭補承務郎，登進士乙科，監紹興府都稅務。

translations.literal: By hereditary privilege he was appointed Gentleman for Court Service, passed the jinshi examination in the second rank, and supervised the general tax bureau of Shaoxing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He entered office through hereditary privilege as a Gentleman for Court Service, passed the jinshi examination in the second tier, and was made supervisor of the combined tax office in Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 請祠歸，杜門力學，不急仕進。

translations.literal: He requested a temple appointment and returned home, shutting his doors to study diligently, not hurrying toward official advancement.
translations.idiomatic: He sought leave to a sinecure post and went home, where he shut himself in to study hard and showed no eagerness to climb the ladder of office.

sentences.zh: 主管西外敦宗院，召除諸王宮大小學教授，遷禮部郎官。

translations.literal: He served as superintendent of the Western Outer Chongzong Institute, was summoned and appointed professor in the great and small schools of the Princes' Establishments, and was transferred to be a secretary in the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He oversaw the Western Outer Chongzong Hall, was then summoned to a professorship in the princely academies, and was promoted to a post in the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 秦檜欲追諡其父，召禮官會問，珙不至，檜怒，風言者逐之。

translations.literal: Qin Hui wished to posthumously ennoble his father; he summoned ritual officials to confer, but Gong did not attend. Qin was angry and had rumor-mongers drive him out.
translations.idiomatic: When Qin Hui sought a posthumous title for his father, he called the ritual officials together for consultation; Gong refused to appear. Qin flew into a rage and used whisper campaigns to have him driven from office.

sentences.zh: 檜死，召為大宗正丞，遷吏部員外郎。

translations.literal: When Qin died, Gong was summoned as vice director of the Imperial Clan Court and transferred to be an assistant minister of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: After Qin's death he was recalled as deputy director of the Imperial Clan Office and promoted to assistant minister in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 置令式庭中，使選集者得自翻閱，與吏辨，吏無得藏其巧。

translations.literal: He placed regulations and forms in the courtyard so that candidates for office could peruse them themselves and dispute with clerks, and clerks could not hide their tricks.
translations.idiomatic: He set out the regulations in the courtyard so candidates for appointment could read them for themselves and argue their case with the clerks, leaving no room for the clerks' sleights of hand.

sentences.zh: 兼權秘書少監，兼權中書舍人。

translations.literal: He also acted as vice director of the Secretariat and acting drafting companion at the Secretariat Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: He also served concurrently as vice director of the Secretariat and acting Secretariat drafter.

sentences.zh: 金犯邊，王師北向，詔檄多出其手，詞氣激烈，聞者泣下。

translations.literal: When the Jin invaded the border and the imperial armies marched north, many of the edicts and proclamations came from his hand; their wording was fierce, and those who heard them wept.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin raided the frontier and the imperial armies marched north, many of the edicts and battle proclamations were drafted by his hand; their language was fierce, and those who heard them wept.

sentences.zh: 御史杜莘老劾宦者張去為，忤旨左遷，珙不草制，莘老得不去。

translations.literal: The censor Du Shenlao impeached the eunuch Zhang Quwei; defying the throne he was demoted, but Gong refused to draft the appointment document, so Shenlao was not removed after all.
translations.idiomatic: The censor Du Shenlao impeached the eunuch Zhang Quwei; defying the throne, Shenlao was demoted, but Gong refused to draft the appointment edict, so Shenlao was not removed after all.

sentences.zh: 從幸建康，兼直學士院。

translations.literal: He accompanied the emperor to Jiankang and concurrently served in the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He accompanied the emperor to Jiankang and concurrently served in the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 車駕將還，軍務未有所付，時張浚留守建康，眾望屬之。

translations.literal: As the imperial carriage was about to return, military affairs had yet to be assigned; Zhang Jun was then stationed in Jiankang, and everyone's hopes rested on him.
translations.idiomatic: As the imperial procession was about to return north, military affairs had yet to be entrusted to anyone; Zhang Jun was then holding Jiankang, and all eyes turned to him.

sentences.zh: 及詔出，以楊存中為江淮宣撫使，珙不書錄黃，仍論其不可。

translations.literal: When the edict appeared appointing Yang Cunzhong as pacification commissioner of Jiang and Huai, Gong refused to write the confirmation in yellow ink and still argued that it should not be done.
translations.idiomatic: When the edict appeared appointing Yang Cunzhong pacification commissioner of the Jiang and Huai regions, Gong refused to endorse it in the yellow register and continued to argue that the appointment was wrong.

sentences.zh: 上怒，謂宰相曰：「劉珙父為浚所知，此特為浚地耳！」

translations.literal: The emperor was angry and told the chief councillors: "Liu Gong's father was known to Zhang Jun — this is simply making room for Jun!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was furious and told the chief councillors, "Liu Gong's father was a protégé of Zhang Jun — this is nothing but clearing the way for Jun!"

sentences.zh: 命再下，宰相召珙諭旨，且曰：「再繳則累張公。」

translations.literal: The order was issued again; the chief councillors summoned Gong to convey the imperial intent and said, "If you reject it again you will implicate Lord Zhang."
translations.idiomatic: The order was issued again; the chief councillors summoned Gong to convey the imperial intent and warned, "If you reject it once more, you will bring trouble on Lord Zhang."

sentences.zh: 珙曰：「某為國家計，豈暇為張公謀。」

translations.literal: Gong said, "I am thinking of the state — how would I have leisure to scheme for Lord Zhang?"
translations.idiomatic: Gong replied, "I am acting for the sake of the state — how would I have time to plot for Lord Zhang?"

sentences.zh: 執奏如初，存中命乃寢。

translations.literal: He held to his memorial as before, and Yang Cunzhong's appointment was shelved.
translations.idiomatic: He held to his memorial as before, and Yang Cunzhong's appointment was shelved.

sentences.zh: 真除中書舍人、直學士院。

translations.literal: He was formally appointed drafting companion at the Secretariat and member of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He was formally appointed Secretariat drafter and Hanlin academician.

sentences.zh: 田師中死，其家請以沒入王繼先第為賜，李珂關通近習，求為督府掾，詔從中下，珙皆論罷之。

translations.literal: When Tian Shizhong died, his family asked that the confiscated residence of Wang Jixian be granted them as a reward; Li Ke had connections with court favorites and sought a staff post in the command headquarters — in each case the edict came down from the Secretariat and Gong argued both down.
translations.idiomatic: When Tian Shizhong died, his family asked that Wang Jixian's confiscated mansion be granted them as a reward; Li Ke, who had ties to the emperor's intimates, sought a staff post at the command headquarters — in each case the edict came down from the Secretariat, and Gong argued both measures down.

sentences.zh: 出知泉州，改衢州。

translations.literal: He went out as prefect of Quanzhou and was transferred to Quzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as prefect of Quanzhou and then transferred to Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 湖南旱，郴州宜章縣李金為亂，朝廷憂之，以珙知潭州、湖南安撫使。

translations.literal: Hunan suffered drought; Li Jin raised a rebellion in Yizhang county, Chen prefecture; the court was worried and appointed Gong prefect of Tanzhou and pacification commissioner of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan was stricken by drought, and Li Jin raised a rebellion in Yizhang county of Chen prefecture; alarmed, the court appointed Gong prefect of Tanzhou and pacification commissioner of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 入境，聲言發郡縣兵討擊，而移書制使沈介，請以便宜出師，曰：「擅興之罪，吾自當之。」

translations.literal: On entering his jurisdiction he announced he would mobilize prefectural and county troops to attack, and wrote to the military commissioner Shen Jie asking permission to take emergency action, saying: "The crime of unauthorized campaigning — I myself will bear it."
translations.idiomatic: On entering his jurisdiction he announced that he would mobilize prefectural and county troops to attack, and wrote to the military commissioner Shen Jie requesting leave to act on his own authority, saying, "If there is guilt in raising troops without authorization, I alone will bear it."

sentences.zh: 介即遣田寶、楊欽以兵至，珙知其暑行疲怠，發夫數程外迎之，代其負任，至則犒賜過望，軍士感奮。

translations.literal: Jie at once sent Tian Bao and Yang Qin with troops; knowing they were weary from marching in the heat, Gong sent laborers several stages out to meet them, shouldered their loads for them, and when they arrived rewarded them beyond expectation — the soldiers were stirred to zeal.
translations.idiomatic: Jie at once sent Tian Bao and Yang Qin with troops; knowing they were exhausted from marching in the summer heat, Gong sent laborers several stages out to meet them, carried their packs for them, and when they arrived rewarded them beyond all expectation — the troops were stirred to zeal.

sentences.zh: 珙知欽可用，檄諸軍皆受節制，下令募賊徒相捕斬詣吏者，除罪受賞。

translations.literal: Gong knew Qin could be relied on; he ordered all armies to accept his command, and proclaimed that rebels who captured and beheaded one another and brought the head to the authorities would be cleared of guilt and given rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Gong knew that Qin could be relied on; he ordered all armies to accept his command and proclaimed that rebels who captured and beheaded one another and brought the heads to the authorities would be cleared of guilt and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 欽與寶連戰破賊，追至莽山，賊黨曹彥，黃拱執李金以降。

translations.literal: Qin and Bao fought in succession and broke the rebels, pursuing them to Mang Mountain; the rebel followers Cao Yan and Huang Gong seized Li Jin and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Qin and Bao fought in succession and routed the rebels, pursuing them to Mang Mountain; the rebel followers Cao Yan and Huang Gong seized Li Jin and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 支黨竄匿者尚眾，珙諭欽等卻兵，聽其自降，賊相率納兵，給據歸田里。

translations.literal: Many of the scattered followers were still in hiding; Gong instructed Qin and the others to withdraw their troops and let them surrender on their own — the rebels came forward in succession to turn in their weapons, were given certificates, and returned to their villages.
translations.idiomatic: Many scattered followers were still in hiding; Gong instructed Qin and the others to withdraw their troops and let them surrender of their own accord — the rebels came forward in succession to turn in their weapons, were given certificates, and returned to their villages.

sentences.zh: 第上諸將功狀有差，上賜璽書曰：「近世書生但務清談，經綸實才蓋未之見，朕以是每有東晉之憂。

translations.literal: He ranked the generals' merit reports in order of distinction; the emperor sent an imperial letter saying: "Scholars in recent times pursue only lofty talk; true talent for governing is scarcely to be seen — for this I often fear a repeat of the Eastern Jin.
translations.idiomatic: He ranked the generals' merit reports in order of distinction; the emperor sent an imperial letter saying, "Scholars in recent times pursue only lofty talk; true talent for governing is scarcely to be seen — for this I often fear a repeat of the Eastern Jin.

sentences.zh: 今卿既誅群盜，而功狀詳實，諸將優劣，破賊先後，歷歷可觀，宜益勉副朕意。」

translations.literal: Now that you have exterminated the bandits and your merit report is detailed and factual — the generals' merits and defects, who broke the rebels first, all set out plainly — you should strive still more to fulfill my intent."
translations.idiomatic: Now that you have exterminated the bandits and your merit report is detailed and factual — the generals' strengths and weaknesses, who broke the rebels first, all set out plainly — you should strive still more to fulfill my intent."

sentences.zh: 除翰林學士、知制誥兼侍讀，言於上曰：「世儒多病漢高帝不悅學，輕儒生，臣以為高帝所不悅，特腐儒俗學耳。

translations.literal: He was made Hanlin academician, drafter of edicts, and concurrent imperial reader; he said to the emperor: "Scholars of the age fault Han Gaozu for disliking study and slighting the Confucians — I hold that what Gaozu disliked was only pedantic vulgar learning.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Hanlin academician, drafter of edicts, and concurrent imperial reader; he said to the emperor, "Scholars of the age fault Han Gaozu for disliking study and slighting the Confucians — I hold that what Gaozu disliked was only pedantic, vulgar learning.

sentences.zh: 使當時有以二帝三王之學告之，知其必敬信，功烈不止此。」

translations.literal: If at the time someone had taught him the learning of the Two Emperors and Three Kings, I know he would have revered and trusted it, and his achievements would not have stopped here."
translations.idiomatic: If at the time someone had taught him the learning of the Two Emperors and Three Kings, I know he would have revered and trusted it, and his achievements would not have stopped here."

sentences.zh: 因陳聖王之學所以明理正心，為萬事之綱，上亟稱善。

translations.literal: He went on to set forth how the learning of sage-kings illuminates principle and rectifies the mind as the guiding thread of all affairs; the emperor promptly praised it highly.
translations.idiomatic: He went on to explain how the learning of the sage-kings illuminates principle and rectifies the mind as the guiding thread of all affairs; the emperor promptly praised it highly.

sentences.zh: 拜中大夫、同知樞密院事，辭不獲，因進言曰：「汪應辰、陳良翰、張栻學行才能，皆臣所不逮，而栻窮探聖微，曉暢軍務，曩幸破賊，栻謀為多，願亟召用。」

translations.literal: He was appointed Grand Master of the Palace and vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; unable to decline, he thereupon memorialized: "Wang Yingchen, Chen Lianghan, and Zhang Shi in learning, conduct, and ability all surpass me — and Shi has exhaustively investigated the subtlety of the sages and is thoroughly versed in military affairs; when we fortunately crushed the rebels, much of the planning was Shi's — I urge that they be summoned and employed at once."
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Grand Master of the Palace and vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; unable to decline, he memorialized, "Wang Yingchen, Chen Lianghan, and Zhang Shi in learning, conduct, and ability all surpass me — and Shi has exhaustively probed the subtle teachings of the sages and is thoroughly versed in military affairs; when we fortunately crushed the rebels, much of the planning was Shi's — I urge that they be summoned and employed at once."

sentences.zh: 上可其奏。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his memorial.

sentences.zh: 兼參知政事。

translations.literal: He also served as Vice Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: He also served as Vice Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 奏除福建鈔鹽歲額二萬萬，罷江西和糴及廣西折米鹽錢，及蠲諸路累年逋負金錢穀帛巨億計。

translations.literal: He memorialized to abolish Fujian's annual salt monopoly quota of two hundred million, end Jiangxi's grain requisition purchases and Guangxi's rice conversion salt payments, and remit accumulated tax arrears in money, grain, and silk across the circuits — amounting to hundreds of millions.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to abolish Fujian's annual salt monopoly quota of two hundred million strings, end Jiangxi's grain requisition purchases and Guangxi's rice-conversion salt payments, and remit accumulated tax arrears in money, grain, and silk across the circuits — amounting to hundreds of millions.

sentences.zh: 上嘗以久旱齋居禱雨，一夕而應，珙進言曰：「陛下誠心感格，其應如響，天人相與之際，真不容發，隱微纖芥之失，其應豈不亦猶是乎？

translations.literal: The emperor once, during a long drought, kept pure quarters and prayed for rain — and within a night it came; Gong advanced and said: "Your Majesty's sincere heart moved Heaven; the response was like an echo. At the juncture where Heaven and man meet, truly not a hair's breadth may intervene — would not a fault as fine as a gossamer thread draw a response likewise?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor once, during a long drought, kept pure quarters and prayed for rain — and within a night it came; Gong advanced and said, "Your Majesty's sincere heart moved Heaven; the response was like an echo. At the juncture where Heaven and man meet, truly not a hair's breadth may intervene — would not a fault as fine as a gossamer thread draw a response likewise?

sentences.zh: 臣願益謹其獨。」

translations.literal: I beg that Your Majesty be still more careful in solitude."
translations.idiomatic: I beg that Your Majesty be still more careful in solitude."

sentences.zh: 上竦然稱善。

translations.literal: The emperor started in surprise and praised it highly.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor started in surprise and praised it highly.

sentences.zh: 龍大淵、曾覿既被逐，未幾，大淵死，上憐覿欲還之。

translations.literal: Long Dayuan and Zeng Di had already been driven out; before long Dayuan died, and the emperor pitied Di and wished to recall him.
translations.idiomatic: Long Dayuan and Zeng Di had already been driven out; before long Dayuan died, and the emperor pitied Di and wished to recall him.

sentences.zh: 珙言：「二人之去，天下方仰威斷。

translations.literal: Gong said: "When those two men were removed, the empire had just begun to look up to Your Majesty's firm resolve.
translations.idiomatic: Gong said, "When those two men were removed, the empire had just begun to look up to Your Majesty's firm resolve.

sentences.zh: 此曹奴隸耳，厚賜之可也，若引以自近，使與聞機事，進退人才，非所以光德業、振紀綱。」

translations.literal: These creatures are mere slaves — generous gifts are enough; but to draw them close, let them hear state secrets, and advance or dismiss talent — that is not how to glorify virtue or revive discipline."
translations.idiomatic: These creatures are mere slaves — generous gifts are enough; but to draw them close, let them hear state secrets, and advance or dismiss talent — that is not how to glorify virtue or revive discipline."

sentences.zh: 命遂止。

translations.literal: The order was then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The order was then stopped.

sentences.zh: 殿前指揮使王琪被旨，按視兩淮城壁，還，密薦和州教授劉甄夫。

translations.literal: Wang Qi, commander of the Palace Front Guard, received the imperial command to inspect the fortifications of the two Huai regions; on returning he secretly recommended Liu Zhenfu, professor at He prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Qi, commander of the Palace Front Guard, received the imperial command to inspect the fortifications of the two Huai regions; on returning he secretly recommended Liu Zhenfu, professor at He prefecture.

sentences.zh: 上諭執政召之，珙請曰：「此人名位微，何自知之？」

translations.literal: The emperor told the chief councillors to summon him; Gong asked: "This man's name and rank are low — how did he come to Your Majesty's knowledge?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the chief councillors to summon him; Gong asked, "This man's name and rank are low — how did he come to Your Majesty's knowledge?"

sentences.zh: 上以琪告。

translations.literal: The emperor said Qi had told him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said Qi had told him.

sentences.zh: 珙退坐堂上，追琪至，詰其故，授牘使對。

translations.literal: Gong withdrew and sat in the hall, had Qi pursued and brought back, questioned him as to the reason, and handed him a document to answer in writing.
translations.idiomatic: Gong withdrew and sat in the hall, had Qi pursued and brought back, questioned him as to the reason, and handed him a document to answer in writing.

sentences.zh: 珙恐，請後不敢，乃叱使責戒勵狀而去。

translations.literal: Qi was afraid and begged that he would not dare again — Gong thereupon rebuked him and sent him off with a written admonition of encouragement and warning.
translations.idiomatic: Qi was afraid and begged that he would not dare again — Gong thereupon rebuked him and sent him off with a written admonition of encouragement and warning.

sentences.zh: 會揚州奏琪檄郡增築新城，珙遂奏罷琪，語在《陳俊卿傳》。

translations.literal: As it happened Yangzhou reported that Qi had ordered the prefecture to add and build a new city wall; Gong then memorialized to dismiss Qi — the account is in the biography of Chen Junqing.
translations.idiomatic: As it happened Yangzhou reported that Qi had ordered the prefecture to expand and build a new city wall; Gong then memorialized to dismiss Qi — the account is in the biography of Chen Junqing.

sentences.zh: 珙時爭之尤力，殿中皆驚，以故獨罷為端明殿學士，奉外祠。

translations.literal: Gong at the time argued especially forcefully; everyone in the hall was startled, and for this reason alone he was demoted to academician of the Duanming Hall and given an outside sinecure.
translations.idiomatic: Gong at the time argued especially forcefully; everyone in the hall was startled, and for this reason alone he was demoted to academician of the Duanming Hall and given an outside sinecure.

sentences.zh: 陳俊卿言：「珙正直有才，肯任怨，臣所不及，願留之。」

translations.literal: Chen Junqing said: "Gong is upright and talented and willing to shoulder blame — what I cannot match — I beg that he be kept."
translations.idiomatic: Chen Junqing said, "Gong is upright and talented and willing to shoulder blame — what I cannot match — I beg that he be kept."

sentences.zh: 詔改知隆興府、江西安撫使。

translations.literal: An edict changed him to prefect of Longxing and pacification commissioner of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: An edict changed his appointment to prefect of Longxing and pacification commissioner of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 入辭，猶以六事為獻，上曰：「卿雖去國，不忘忠言，材美非他人所及，行召卿矣。」

translations.literal: On entering to take leave he still presented six matters; the emperor said: "Though you leave the capital you do not forget loyal counsel; your talent is not matched by others — you will soon be recalled."
translations.idiomatic: On entering to take leave he still presented six matters; the emperor said, "Though you leave the capital you do not forget loyal counsel; your talent is not matched by others — you will soon be recalled."

sentences.zh: 至鎮，首蠲稅務新額，及罷苗倉大斛。

translations.literal: When he reached his post he first remitted new tax quotas at the commercial offices and abolished the large pecks at the seedling granaries.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached his post he first remitted new tax quotas at the commercial offices and abolished the large pecks at the seedling granaries.

sentences.zh: 屬邑奉新有復出租稅，窮民不能輸，相率逃去，反失正稅，並奏除之。

translations.literal: In the subordinate county Fengxin there had been a restoration of quit-rent taxes; the destitute could not pay and fled in bands, which in turn cost the regular tax — he memorialized to abolish these as well.
translations.idiomatic: In the subordinate county Fengxin quit-rent taxes had been restored; the destitute could not pay and fled in bands, which in turn cost the regular tax revenue — he memorialized to abolish these as well.

sentences.zh: 除資政殿學士、知荊南府、湖北安撫使，以繼母憂去。

translations.literal: He was made academician of the Zizheng Hall, prefect of Jingnan, and pacification commissioner of Hubei, and left office on mourning for his stepmother.
translations.idiomatic: He was made academician of the Zizheng Hall, prefect of Jingnan, and pacification commissioner of Hubei, and left office to mourn his stepmother.

sentences.zh: 起復同知樞密院事、荊襄安撫使。

translations.literal: He was recalled from mourning to be vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and pacification commissioner of Jing and Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled from mourning to serve as vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and pacification commissioner of Jing and Xiang.

sentences.zh: 珙六上奏懇辭，引經據禮，詞甚切，最後言曰：「三年通喪，三代未之有改，漢儒乃有 『金革無避』之說，已為先王罪人。

translations.literal: Gong six times memorialized earnestly to decline, citing classics and ritual — his language very urgent; at last he said: "The three-year mourning period was unchanged through the Three Dynasties; Han Confucians invented the saying 'in time of war, arms brook no evasion' — they were already sinners against the former kings.
translations.idiomatic: Gong six times memorialized earnestly to decline, citing classics and ritual — his language very urgent; at last he said, "The three-year mourning period was unchanged through the Three Dynasties; Han Confucians invented the saying 'in time of war, arms brook no evasion' — they were already sinners against the former kings.

sentences.zh: 今邊陲幸無犬吠之驚，臣乃欲冒金革之名，以私利祿之實，不亦又為漢儒之罪人乎？」

translations.literal: Now the frontier fortunately knows no alarm so slight as a dog's bark — yet I would take the name of 'arms' to seek the substance of salary for private gain — would I not be a sinner against the Han Confucians as well?"
translations.idiomatic: Now the frontier fortunately knows no alarm so slight as a dog's bark — yet I would take the name of 'arms' to seek the substance of salary for private gain — would I not be a sinner against the Han Confucians as well?"

sentences.zh: 服闋，再除知潭州、湖南安撫使。

translations.literal: When mourning was complete he was again appointed prefect of Tanzhou and pacification commissioner of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning was complete he was again appointed prefect of Tanzhou and pacification commissioner of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 過闕入見，極論時事，言甚切至，上再三加勞，進資政殿大學士以行。

translations.literal: Passing the capital he entered audience and spoke exhaustively on current affairs — his words very urgent; the emperor repeatedly exhorted and encouraged him and advanced him to Grand Academician of the Zizheng Hall before he departed.
translations.idiomatic: Passing through the capital he entered audience and spoke exhaustively on current affairs — his words very urgent; the emperor repeatedly exhorted and encouraged him and advanced him to Grand Academician of the Zizheng Hall before he departed.

sentences.zh: 安南貢象，所過發夫除道，毀屋廬，數十州騷然。

translations.literal: Annan sent tribute elephants; wherever they passed laborers were conscripted to clear the road and houses were torn down — dozens of prefectures were thrown into uproar.
translations.idiomatic: Annam sent tribute elephants; wherever they passed laborers were conscripted to clear the roads and houses were torn down — dozens of prefectures were thrown into uproar.

sentences.zh: 珙奏曰：「象之用於郊祀，不見於經，驅而遠之，則有若周公之典。

translations.literal: Gong memorialized: "The use of elephants in suburban sacrifice is not seen in the classics; to drive them away would accord with the precedent of the Duke of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Gong memorialized, "The use of elephants in suburban sacrifice is not seen in the classics; to drive them away would accord with the precedent of the Duke of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 且使吾中國之疲民，困於遠夷之野獸，豈仁聖之所為哉！」

translations.literal: Moreover, to let the worn-out people of our Middle Kingdom suffer for the wild beasts of distant barbarians — is that what a benevolent sage would do!"
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, to let the worn-out people of our Middle Kingdom suffer for the wild beasts of distant barbarians — is that what a benevolent sage would do!"

sentences.zh: 湖北茶盜數千人入境，疆吏以告，珙曰：「此非必死之寇，緩之則散而求生，急之則聚而致死。」

translations.literal: Hubei tea bandits numbering several thousand crossed the border; border officials reported it; Gong said: "These are not bandits who must fight to the death — if treated gently they will scatter and seek to live; pressed hard they will gather and fight to die."
translations.idiomatic: Several thousand Hubei tea bandits crossed the border; border officials reported it; Gong said, "These are not bandits who must fight to the death — if treated gently they will scatter and seek to live; pressed hard they will gather and fight to the death."

sentences.zh: 揭榜諭以自新，聲言兵且至，令屬州縣具數千人食，盜果散去，其存者無幾。

translations.literal: He posted a proclamation urging them to reform, announced that troops were about to arrive, and ordered subordinate prefectures and counties to prepare food for several thousand men — the bandits indeed scattered, and those who remained were few.
translations.idiomatic: He posted a proclamation urging them to reform, announced that troops were about to arrive, and ordered subordinate prefectures and counties to prepare food for several thousand men — the bandits indeed scattered, and those who remained were few.

sentences.zh: 珙乃遣兵，戒曰：「來毋亟戰，去毋窮追，不去者擊之耳。」

translations.literal: He then sent troops with orders: "When they come do not fight at once; when they go do not pursue to the end — only strike those who do not go."
translations.idiomatic: He then sent troops with orders, "When they come do not fight at once; when they go do not pursue to the end — only strike those who do not go."

sentences.zh: 盜意益緩，於是一戰敗之，盡擒以歸，誅首惡數十，餘隸軍籍。

translations.literal: The bandits grew still more relaxed in intent; in one battle they were defeated, all captured and brought back — several dozen ringleaders were executed and the rest enrolled in the army registers.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits grew still more relaxed in intent; in one battle they were defeated, all captured and brought back — several dozen ringleaders were executed and the rest enrolled in the army registers.

sentences.zh: 淳熙二年，移知建康府、江東安撫使、行宮留守。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chunxi he was transferred to prefect of Jiankang, pacification commissioner of Jiangdong, and resident steward of the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chunxi he was transferred to prefect of Jiankang, pacification commissioner of Jiangdong, and resident steward of the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 會水且旱，首奏蠲夏稅錢六十萬緡、秋苗米十六萬六千斛。

translations.literal: When there was flooding and also drought, he first memorialized to remit summer tax money of six hundred thousand strings and autumn seedling rice of one hundred sixty-six thousand bushels.
translations.idiomatic: When there was flooding and also drought, he first memorialized to remit summer tax money of six hundred thousand strings and autumn seedling rice of one hundred sixty-six thousand bushels.

sentences.zh: 禁止上流稅米遏糴，得商人米三百萬斛。

translations.literal: He forbade upstream tax rice from blocking grain purchases and obtained three million bushels of merchants' rice.
translations.idiomatic: He forbade upstream tax rice from blocking grain purchases and obtained three million bushels of merchants' rice.

sentences.zh: 貸諸司錢合三萬，遣官糴米上江，得十四萬九千斛。

translations.literal: He borrowed thirty thousand strings in all from various offices, sent officials to purchase rice upriver, and obtained one hundred forty-nine thousand bushels.
translations.idiomatic: He borrowed thirty thousand strings in all from various offices, sent officials to purchase rice upriver, and obtained one hundred forty-nine thousand bushels.

sentences.zh: 籍主客戶高下，給米有差。

translations.literal: He registered resident and migrant households by rank and distributed rice with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: He registered resident and migrant households by rank and distributed rice with distinctions.

sentences.zh: 又運米村落，置場平價振糶，貸者不取償。

translations.literal: He also transported rice to villages, set up markets to sell grain at fair prices for relief, and those who borrowed were not required to repay.
translations.idiomatic: He also transported rice to villages, set up markets to sell grain at fair prices for relief, and those who borrowed were not required to repay.

sentences.zh: 起是年九月，盡明年四月，闔境數十萬人，無一人捐瘠流徙者。

translations.literal: From the ninth month of that year through the fourth month of the next, throughout the jurisdiction several hundred thousand people — not one wasted away or fled.
translations.idiomatic: From the ninth month of that year through the fourth month of the next, throughout the jurisdiction several hundred thousand people — not one wasted away or fled.

sentences.zh: 珙精明果斷，居家孝，喪繼母卓氏，年已逾五十，盡哀致毀，內外功緦之戚，必素服以終月數。

translations.literal: Gong was sharp-minded, resolute, and filial at home; mourning his stepmother the Lady Zhuo, though already past fifty, he exhausted grief to the point of self-injury, and for all relatives within the five degrees of mourning he invariably wore plain dress for the full month count.
translations.idiomatic: Gong was sharp-minded, resolute, and filial at home; mourning his stepmother the Lady Zhuo, though already past fifty, he exhausted grief to the point of self-injury, and for all relatives within the five degrees of mourning he invariably wore plain dress for the full month count.

sentences.zh: 喜受盡言，事有小失，下吏言之立改。

translations.literal: He delighted in hearing blunt speech; if there was a small fault and a subordinate spoke of it he corrected it at once.
translations.idiomatic: He delighted in hearing blunt speech; if there was a small fault and a subordinate spoke of it he corrected it at once.

sentences.zh: 臨數鎮，民愛之若父母，聞訃，有罷市巷哭相與祠之者。

translations.literal: Over several posts the people loved him as parents; when news of his death came, some closed markets, wept in the lanes, and together set up shrines to him.
translations.idiomatic: Over several posts the people loved him as parents; when news of his death came, some closed markets, wept in the lanes, and together set up shrines to him.

sentences.zh: 王藺，字謙仲、廬江人。

translations.literal: Wang Lin, styled Qianzhong, was a man of Lujiang.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lin, courtesy name Qianzhong, was a native of Lujiang.

sentences.zh: 乾道五年，擢進士第。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Qiandao he was selected in the jinshi degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Qiandao he passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 為信州上饒簿、鄂州教授、四川宣撫司幹辦公事，除武學諭。

translations.literal: He served as recorder of Shangrao in Xin prefecture, professor at E prefecture, and staff clerk of the Sichuan pacification commission, and was appointed instructor at the Military Studies academy.
translations.idiomatic: He served as recorder of Shangrao in Xin prefecture, professor at E prefecture, and staff clerk of the Sichuan pacification commission, and was appointed instructor at the Military Studies Academy.

sentences.zh: 孝宗幸學，藺迎法駕，立道周，上目而異之，命小黃門問知姓名，由是簡記。

translations.literal: When Xiaozong visited the academy, Lin greeted the imperial procession and stood along the roadway; the emperor looked at him with surprise, ordered a junior eunuch to ask his name — from this he was marked for favor.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiaozong visited the academy, Lin greeted the imperial procession and stood along the roadway; the emperor looked at him with surprise, ordered a junior eunuch to ask his name — from this he was marked for favor.

sentences.zh: 遷樞密院編修官，輪對，奏五事，讀未竟，上喜見顏色。

translations.literal: He was transferred to compiler at the Bureau of Military Affairs; in rotation audience he presented five matters — before he had finished reading, pleasure showed in the emperor's face.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to compiler at the Bureau of Military Affairs; in rotation audience he presented five matters — before he had finished reading, pleasure showed in the emperor's face.

sentences.zh: 明日，諭輔臣曰：「王藺敢言，宜加獎擢。」

translations.literal: The next day he told the chief ministers: "Wang Lin dares to speak — he should be rewarded and promoted."
translations.idiomatic: The next day he told the chief ministers, "Wang Lin dares to speak — he should be rewarded and promoted."

sentences.zh: 除宗正丞，尋出守舒州。

translations.literal: He was appointed vice director of the Imperial Clan Court; soon after he went out as prefect of Shuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice director of the Imperial Clan Court; soon after he went out as prefect of Shuzhou.

sentences.zh: 陛辭，奏疏數條，皆極言時事之未得其正者，上曰：「卿議論峭直。」

translations.literal: At audience on taking leave he submitted several memorials, all speaking urgently of where current affairs had not yet been set right; the emperor said: "Your discourse is steep and straight."
translations.idiomatic: At audience on taking leave he submitted several memorials, all speaking urgently of where current affairs had not yet been set right; the emperor said, "Your discourse is steep and straight."

sentences.zh: 尋出手詔：「王藺鯁直敢言，除監察御史。」

translations.literal: Soon an edict in the emperor's hand appeared: "Wang Lin is blunt and dares to speak — appointed investigating censor."
translations.idiomatic: Soon an edict in the emperor's hand appeared: "Wang Lin is blunt and dares to speak — appointed investigating censor."

sentences.zh: 一日，上袖出幅紙賜之，曰：「比覽陸贄《奏議》，所陳深切，今日之政恐有如德宗之弊者，可思朕之闕失，條陳來上。」

translations.literal: One day the emperor took a sheet of paper from his sleeve and gave it to him, saying: "Recently reading Lu Zhi's Memorials — what he set forth is profound; today's government may harbor evils like those of Dezong — reflect on my shortcomings and submit them item by item."
translations.idiomatic: One day the emperor took a sheet of paper from his sleeve and gave it to him, saying, "Recently reading Lu Zhi's Memorials — what he set forth is profound; today's government may harbor evils like those of Dezong — reflect on my shortcomings and submit them item by item."

sentences.zh: 藺即對曰：「德宗之失，在於自用遂非，疑天下士。」

translations.literal: Lin answered at once: "Dezong's fault lay in trusting only himself, persisting in error, and suspecting the empire's scholars."
translations.idiomatic: Lin answered at once, "Dezong's fault lay in trusting only himself, persisting in error, and suspecting the empire's scholars."

sentences.zh: 退即上疏，陳德宗之弊，並及時政闕失，上嘉納之。

translations.literal: On withdrawing he immediately submitted a memorial setting forth Dezong's faults and also the gaps in current policy; the emperor praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: On withdrawing he immediately submitted a memorial setting forth Dezong's faults and also the gaps in current policy; the emperor praised and accepted it.

sentences.zh: 遷起居舍人，言：「朝廷除授失當，臺諫不悉舉職，給、舍始廢繳駁，內官、醫官、藥官賜予之多，遷轉之易，可不思警懼而正之乎？」

translations.literal: He was made recorder of the emperor and said: "Court appointments are often improper, the censorate and remonstrance bureau do not fully perform their duties, the drafting and recording offices have only now ceased rejecting documents in yellow — the lavish grants to inner eunuchs, medical officers, and pharmacy officers, the ease of their promotions — should we not think to be vigilant and set this right?"
translations.idiomatic: He was made recorder of the emperor and said, "Court appointments are often improper, the censorate and remonstrance bureau do not fully perform their duties, the drafting and recording offices have only now ceased rejecting documents in yellow — the lavish grants to inner eunuchs, medical officers, and pharmacy officers, the ease of their promotions — should we not think to be vigilant and set this right?"

sentences.zh: 上竦然曰：「非卿言，朕皆不聞。

translations.literal: The emperor started and said: "But for your words I would have heard none of this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor started and said, "But for your words I would have heard none of this.

sentences.zh: 磊磊落落，惟卿一人。」

translations.literal: You stand alone — forthright and unencumbered."
translations.idiomatic: You stand alone — forthright and unencumbered."

sentences.zh: 除禮部侍郎兼吏部。

translations.literal: He was appointed vice minister of Rites and concurrent charge of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice minister of Rites with concurrent charge of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 嘗因手詔「謀選監司，欲得剛正如卿者，可舉數人。」

translations.literal: Once, by edict in the emperor's hand: "We plan to select circuit intendants and wish to have men as firm and upright as you — you may recommend several."
translations.idiomatic: Once, by edict in the emperor's hand: "We plan to select circuit intendants and wish to have men as firm and upright as you — you may recommend several."

sentences.zh: 即奏舉潘時、鄭矯、林大中等八人，乞擢用。

translations.literal: He at once memorialized recommending eight men including Pan Shi, Zheng Jiao, and Lin Dazhong, and begged that they be promoted and employed.
translations.idiomatic: He at once memorialized recommending eight men including Pan Shi, Zheng Jiao, and Lin Dazhong, and begged that they be promoted and employed.

sentences.zh: 會以母憂去。

translations.literal: He happened to leave on mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: He left office to mourn his mother.

sentences.zh: 服除，召還為禮部尚書，進參知政事。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was summoned back as minister of Rites and advanced to Vice Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was summoned back as minister of Rites and advanced to Vice Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 光宗即位，遷知樞密院事兼參政，拜樞密使。

translations.literal: When Guangzong ascended the throne he was transferred to director of the Bureau of Military Affairs with concurrent Vice Grand Councillor rank and appointed Military Affairs Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Guangzong ascended the throne he was transferred to director of the Bureau of Military Affairs with concurrent Vice Grand Councillor rank and appointed Military Affairs Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 光宗精厲初政，藺亦不存形跡，除目或自中出，未愜人心者，輒留之，納諸御坐。

translations.literal: Guangzong was energetic in his early reign; Lin likewise kept no regard for appearances — when appointment documents sometimes came from the inner palace that did not satisfy popular sentiment, he would hold them back and place them before the imperial seat.
translations.idiomatic: Guangzong was energetic in his early reign; Lin likewise kept no regard for appearances — when appointment documents sometimes came from the inner palace that did not satisfy popular sentiment, he would hold them back and place them before the imperial seat.

sentences.zh: 或議建皇后家廟，力爭以為不可，因應詔上疏「願陛下先定聖志」，條列八事，疏入，不報。

translations.literal: Some proposed building the empress's family temple; he argued strongly that it should not be done, and in response to an imperial edict submitted a memorial, "I beg Your Majesty first to fix your sagely resolve," listing eight items; the memorial entered but received no reply.
translations.idiomatic: When some proposed building the empress's family temple, he argued forcefully that it should not be done, and in response to an imperial edict submitted a memorial, "I beg Your Majesty first to fix your sagely resolve," listing eight items; the memorial was submitted but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 中丞何澹論之，以罷去。

translations.literal: Vice censor-in-chief He Dan impeached him and he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Vice censor-in-chief He Dan impeached him, and he was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 起帥閫，易鎮蜀，皆不就。

translations.literal: He was summoned to command the armies and transferred to command Shu — he accepted neither.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to command the armies and transferred to command Shu — he accepted neither appointment.

sentences.zh: 後領祠，帥江陵。

translations.literal: Later he held a temple sinecure and commanded Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: Later he held a temple sinecure and commanded Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 寧宗即位，改帥湖南。

translations.literal: When Ningzong ascended the throne he was changed to command Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: When Ningzong ascended the throne he was reassigned to command Hunan.

sentences.zh: 臺臣論罷，歸里奉祠。

translations.literal: Censorial officials impeached him and he was dismissed; he returned home to a temple sinecure.
translations.idiomatic: Censorial officials impeached him and he was dismissed; he returned home to a temple sinecure.

sentences.zh: 七年薨。

translations.literal: He died in the seventh year.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the seventh year.

sentences.zh: 藺盡言無隱，然嫉惡太甚，同列多忌之，竟以不合去。

translations.literal: Lin spoke without concealment, but his hatred of evil was too severe; colleagues mostly resented him, and in the end he left because he did not fit.
translations.idiomatic: Lin spoke without concealment, but his hatred of evil was too severe; colleagues mostly resented him, and in the end he left because he did not fit in.

sentences.zh: 有《奏議》傳於世。

translations.literal: His Memorials circulate in the world.
translations.idiomatic: His Memorials circulate in the world.

sentences.zh: 黃祖舜

translations.literal: Huang Zushun
translations.idiomatic: Huang Zushun

sentences.zh: 黃祖舜，福州福清人。

translations.literal: Huang Zushun was a man of Fuqing in Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Zushun was a native of Fuqing in Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 登進士第，累任至軍器監丞。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi degree and rose through posts to vice director of the Armaments Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination and rose through posts to vice director of the Armaments Directorate.

sentences.zh: 入對，言：「縣令付銓曹，專用資格，曷若委郡守，汰其尤無良者。」

translations.literal: In audience he said: "County magistrates are entrusted to the personnel office and appointed solely by seniority — how much better to entrust them to prefects and eliminate the worst."
translations.idiomatic: In audience he said, "County magistrates are entrusted to the personnel office and appointed solely by seniority — how much better to entrust them to prefects and eliminate the worst among them."

sentences.zh: 上然之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 權守尚書屯田員外郎，徙吏部員外郎，出通判泉州。

translations.literal: Acting as secretary in the Ministry of Revenue's cultivation fields, he was transferred to assistant minister of Personnel and went out as vice prefect of Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Acting as secretary in the Ministry of Revenue's cultivation fields, he was transferred to assistant minister of Personnel and went out as vice prefect of Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 將行，言：「抱道懷德之士，不應試干祿，老于韋布。

translations.literal: About to depart, he said: "Men who embrace the Way and cherish virtue should not seek office through examination; they grow old in common cloth.
translations.idiomatic: About to depart, he said, "Men who embrace the Way and cherish virtue should not seek office through examination; they grow old in common cloth.

sentences.zh: 乞自科舉外，有學行修明、孝友純篤者，縣薦之州，州延之庠序，以表率多士；

translations.literal: I beg that outside the examination system, for those of cultivated learning and upright conduct, pure in filial piety and friendship, counties recommend them to prefectures and prefectures invite them to school halls as models for the many scholars;
translations.idiomatic: I beg that outside the examination system, for those of cultivated learning and upright conduct, pure in filial piety and friendship, counties recommend them to prefectures and prefectures invite them to school halls as models for the many scholars;

sentences.zh: 其卓行尤異者，州以名聞，是亦鄉舉里選之意。」

translations.literal: and for those of outstanding conduct especially, prefectures report their names — this too is the intent of village recommendation and district selection."
translations.idiomatic: and for those of outstanding conduct especially, prefectures report their names — this too is the intent of village recommendation and district selection."

sentences.zh: 下其奏禮部，遂留為倉部郎中，遷右司郎中、權刑部侍郎兼詳定敕令司兼侍講。

translations.literal: His memorial went down to the Ministry of Rites; he was kept as director in the granaries bureau, promoted to director in the right bureau, acting vice minister of Justice concurrently detailing statutes and concurrent lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: His memorial went down to the Ministry of Rites; he was kept as director in the granaries bureau, promoted to director in the right bureau, acting vice minister of Justice concurrently detailing statutes and concurrent lecturer.

sentences.zh: 進《論語講義》，上命金安節校勘，安節言其書詞義明粹，乃令國子監板行。

translations.literal: He presented Exegesis of the Analects; the emperor ordered Jin Anjie to collate it; Anjie said its language and meaning were clear and pure, and it was ordered printed by the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: He presented Exegesis of the Analects; the emperor ordered Jin Anjie to collate it; Anjie said its language and meaning were clear and pure, and it was ordered printed by the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 薦李寶勇足以冠軍，智足以料敵，詔以寶為帶御器械。

translations.literal: He recommended Li Bao as brave enough to lead armies and wise enough to gauge the enemy; an edict appointed Bao keeper of imperial arms.
translations.idiomatic: He recommended Li Bao as brave enough to lead armies and wise enough to gauge the enemy; an edict appointed Bao keeper of imperial arms.

sentences.zh: 遷同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 金主亮犯淮，劉汜敗，王權走，上將誅權以厲其餘，祖舜言：「權罪當誅，汜不容貸。

translations.literal: When the Jin ruler Hailing invaded Huai, Liu Bi was defeated and Wang Quan fled; the emperor was about to execute Quan to warn the rest; Zushun said: "Quan's crime deserves death and Bi cannot be spared.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin ruler Hailing invaded Huai, Liu Bi was defeated and Wang Quan fled; the emperor was about to execute Quan to warn the rest; Zushun said, "Quan's crime deserves death and Bi cannot be spared.

sentences.zh: 劉錡有大功，聞其病已殆，權、汜誅，錡必媿忿以死，是國家一敗兵而殺三將，得無快於敵乎？」

translations.literal: Liu Qi has great merit; hearing he is gravely ill, if Quan and Bi are executed Qi will surely die of shame and anger — would not the state, having lost one battle, kill three generals and please the enemy?"
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qi has great merit; hearing he is gravely ill, if Quan and Bi are executed Qi will surely die of shame and anger — would not the state, having lost one battle, kill three generals and please the enemy?"

sentences.zh: 上嘉納。

translations.literal: The emperor praised and accepted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and accepted.

sentences.zh: 薨于官，諡「莊定」。

translations.literal: He died in office; posthumous title Zhuangding.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office; posthumous title Zhuangding.

sentences.zh: 王大寶

translations.literal: Wang Dabao
translations.idiomatic: Wang Dabao

sentences.zh: 王大寶，字元龜，其先繇溫陵徙潮州。

translations.literal: Wang Dabao, styled Yuangui, his ancestors moved from Wenling to Chaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Dabao, courtesy name Yuangui, his ancestors moved from Wenling to Chaozhou.

sentences.zh: 政和間，貢辟雍。

translations.literal: During the Zhenghe era he entered the Directorate of Education by tribute.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhenghe era he entered the Directorate of Education by tribute.

sentences.zh: 建炎初，廷試第二，授南雄州教授。

translations.literal: At the start of Jianyan he placed second in the palace examination and was appointed professor of Nanxiong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Jianyan he placed second in the palace examination and was appointed professor of Nanxiong prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以祿不逮養，移病而歸。

translations.literal: Because his salary could not support his parents, he requested leave on grounds of illness and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: Because his salary could not support his parents, he requested leave on grounds of illness and returned home.

sentences.zh: 閱數年，差監登聞鼓院、主管台州崇道觀，復累年。

translations.literal: After several years he was assigned to supervise the Court of Memorials drum office and oversee the Chongdao Abbey in Taizhou; again after several years.
translations.idiomatic: After several years he was assigned to supervise the Court of Memorials drum office and oversee the Chongdao Abbey in Taizhou; again after several years.

sentences.zh: 趙鼎謫潮，大寶日從講《論語》，鼎歎曰：「吾居此，平時所薦無一至者，君獨肯從吾遊，過人遠矣。」

translations.literal: Zhao Ding was banished to Chao; Dabao daily followed him in studying the Analects; Ding sighed: "In my time here none I usually recommended ever comes — only you willingly study with me; you surpass others by far."
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ding was banished to Chao; Dabao daily followed him in studying the Analects; Ding sighed, "In my time here none I usually recommended ever comes — only you willingly study with me; you surpass others by far."

sentences.zh: 知連州。

translations.literal: He became prefect of Lianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He became prefect of Lianzhou.

sentences.zh: 張浚亦謫居，命其子栻與講學。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun was also banished there; he ordered his son Shi to study with him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was also banished there; he ordered his son Shi to study with him.

sentences.zh: 時趙、張客貶斥無虛日，人為累息，大寶獨泰然。

translations.literal: At the time Zhao and Zhang's guests were banished without respite; others held their breath in fear — Dabao alone was calm.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhao and Zhang's guests were banished without respite; others held their breath in fear — Dabao alone was calm.

sentences.zh: 浚奉不時得，大寶以經制錢給之，浚曰：「如累君何？」

translations.literal: Jun did not always receive his stipend; Dabao gave him funds from the fiscal circuit; Jun said: "Would this not implicate you?"
translations.idiomatic: Jun did not always receive his stipend; Dabao gave him funds from the fiscal circuit; Jun said, "Would this not implicate you?"

sentences.zh: 大寶不為變。

translations.literal: Dabao was unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Dabao was unchanged.

sentences.zh: 代還，言連、英、循、惠、新、恩六州，居民才數百，非懋遷之地，月輸免行錢宜蠲減。

translations.literal: On returning from substitute service he said the six prefectures Lian, Ying, Xun, Hui, Xin, and En had only hundreds of residents and were not centers of commerce — the monthly exemption transit fees should be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On returning from substitute service he said the six prefectures Lian, Ying, Xun, Hui, Xin, and En had only hundreds of residents and were not centers of commerce — the monthly exemption transit fees should be reduced.

sentences.zh: 高宗謂大臣曰：「守臣上殿，令陳民事，遂得知田里疾苦，所陳五六，得一可行，其利亦不細矣。」

translations.literal: Gaozong told the ministers: "When frontier officials attend court, let them report civilian affairs — then we learn the hardships of fields and hamlets; of five or six matters raised, if one can be enacted, the benefit is not slight."
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong told the ministers, "When frontier officials attend court, let them report civilian affairs — then we learn the hardships of fields and hamlets; of five or six matters raised, if one can be enacted, the benefit is not slight."

sentences.zh: 乃命廣西諸司具減數聞。

translations.literal: He then ordered the Guangxi offices to report the reduced amounts.
translations.idiomatic: He then ordered the Guangxi offices to report the reduced amounts.

sentences.zh: 知袁州，進《詩》、《書》、《易解》，上謂執政曰：「大寶留意經術，其書甚可采，可與內除。」

translations.literal: As prefect of Yuanzhou he presented Explanations of the Odes, Documents, and Changes; the emperor told the chief councillors: "Dabao attends to classical learning; his books are quite adoptable — he may be promoted within."
translations.idiomatic: As prefect of Yuanzhou he presented Explanations of the Odes, Documents, and Changes; the emperor told the chief councillors, "Dabao attends to classical learning; his books are quite adoptable — he may be promoted within."

sentences.zh: 執政擬國子司業，上喜曰：「適合朕意。」

translations.literal: The chief councillors proposed director of studies at the Directorate; the emperor was pleased: "It suits my intent exactly."
translations.idiomatic: The chief councillors proposed director of studies at the Directorate; the emperor was pleased, "It suits my intent exactly."

sentences.zh: 時經筵闕官，遂除國子司業兼崇政殿說書。

translations.literal: As the classics lecture post was vacant, he was appointed director of studies concurrently lecturer at the Chongzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: As the classics lecture post was vacant, he was appointed director of studies concurrently lecturer at the Chongzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 奏：「江南諸州有月樁錢，無定名數，吏緣為姦，刻剝民。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Jiangnan prefectures have monthly plank money with no fixed name or amount; clerks use it for fraud and exploit the people.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized, "Jiangnan prefectures have monthly plank money with no fixed name or amount; clerks use it for fraud and exploit the people.

sentences.zh: 又有折帛錢，方南渡兵興，物價翔貴，令下戶折納，務以優之，今市帛匹四千，而令輸六千。

translations.literal: There is also silk conversion money; when the court crossed south and war rose, prices soared — lower households were ordered to convert payment, intending to favor them; now silk sells at four thousand per bolt but they must pay six thousand.
translations.idiomatic: There is also silk conversion money; when the court crossed south and war rose, prices soared — lower households were ordered to convert payment, intending to favor them; now silk sells at four thousand per bolt but they must pay six thousand.

sentences.zh: 盍委監司覈月樁為定制，減折帛惠小民。」

translations.literal: Why not commission supervisory officials to verify monthly plank as a fixed regulation and reduce silk conversion to benefit commoners?"
translations.idiomatic: Why not commission supervisory officials to verify monthly plank as a fixed regulation and reduce silk conversion to benefit commoners?"

sentences.zh: 詔戶部詳其奏。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue to review his memorial.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue to review his memorial.

sentences.zh: 直敷文閣、知溫州、提點福建刑獄。

translations.literal: Direct attendant of the Filled Writings Hall, prefect of Wenzhou, judicial intendant of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Direct attendant of the Filled Writings Hall, prefect of Wenzhou, judicial intendant of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 道臨漳，有峻嶺曰蔡岡，藂薄蔽翳，山石犖确，盜乘間剽劫。

translations.literal: Passing Linzhang, there was a steep ridge called Cai Ridge, thickets blocking sight, rocks rugged — bandits seized intervals to rob.
translations.idiomatic: Passing Linzhang, there was a steep ridge called Cai Ridge, thickets blocking sight, rocks rugged — bandits seized intervals to rob.

sentences.zh: 大寶以囊金三十萬，募民抉藪甃道十餘里，行者便之。

translations.literal: Dabao used thirty thousand strings from his purse to hire people to cut thickets and pave the road for more than ten li — travelers found it convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Dabao used thirty thousand strings from his purse to hire people to cut thickets and pave the road for more than ten li — travelers found it convenient.

sentences.zh: 提點廣東刑獄。

translations.literal: Judicial intendant of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Judicial intendant of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 孝宗即位，除禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: When Xiaozong ascended the throne he was appointed vice minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiaozong ascended the throne he was appointed vice minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 大寶言：「古致治之君，先明國是，而行之以果斷。

translations.literal: Dabao said: "Ancient rulers who brought order first clarified the national policy and pursued it with resolution.
translations.idiomatic: Dabao said, "Ancient rulers who brought order first clarified the national policy and pursued it with resolution.

sentences.zh: 自軍興以來，曰征曰和，浮議靡定。

translations.literal: Since war began, some say campaign, some say peace — floating debate never settles.
translations.idiomatic: Since war began, some say campaign, some say peace — floating debate never settles.

sentences.zh: 太上傳丕基於陛下，四方日徯恢復，國論未定，眾志未孚。

translations.literal: The Retired Emperor passed the great foundation to Your Majesty; the four quarters daily await recovery; national debate is unsettled, the multitude's will not won.
translations.idiomatic: The Retired Emperor passed the great foundation to Your Majesty; the four quarters daily await recovery; national debate is unsettled, the multitude's will not won.

sentences.zh: 願陛下果斷，則無不濟。」

translations.literal: I beg Your Majesty be resolute — then nothing will fail."
translations.idiomatic: I beg Your Majesty be resolute — then nothing will fail."

sentences.zh: 擢右諫議大夫，首論朱倬、沈該之罪，皆行其言。

translations.literal: He was promoted to right remonstrance doctor; first he impeached Zhu Chun and Shen Gai — in each case his words were followed.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to right remonstrance doctor; first he impeached Zhu Chun and Shen Gai — in each case his words were followed.

sentences.zh: 汪澈督師荊、襄，大寶劾其不能節制，坐視方城之敗，疏再上，澈落職謫台州。

translations.literal: Wang Che supervised armies in Jing and Xiang; Dabao impeached him for lacking control, sitting by while Fangcheng fell; the memorial was submitted twice — Che was removed and banished to Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Che supervised armies in Jing and Xiang; Dabao impeached him for lacking control, sitting by while Fangcheng fell; the memorial was submitted twice — Che was removed and banished to Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 大寶嘗論及移蹕，上曰：「吾欲亟行。」

translations.literal: Dabao once discussed moving the capital; the emperor said: "I wish to go quickly."
translations.idiomatic: Dabao once discussed moving the capital; the emperor said, "I wish to go quickly."

sentences.zh: 大寶奏：「今日之勢殆未可，願少寬歲月。」

translations.literal: Dabao memorialized: "Today's situation is perhaps not yet ready — I beg a few months' delay."
translations.idiomatic: Dabao memorialized, "Today's situation is perhaps not yet ready — I beg a few months' delay."

sentences.zh: 張浚復起為都督，大寶力贊其議，符離失律，群言洶洶。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun was again raised as supreme commander; Dabao strongly supported his plan; at Fuli discipline broke and talk swirled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was again raised as supreme commander; Dabao strongly supported his plan; at Fuli discipline broke and talk swirled.

sentences.zh: 大寶言：「危疑之際，非果斷持重，何以息橫議。」

translations.literal: Dabao said: "In a time of peril and doubt, without resolute steadiness how can rampant talk be stilled?"
translations.idiomatic: Dabao said, "In a time of peril and doubt, without resolute steadiness how can rampant talk be stilled?"

sentences.zh: 未幾，湯思退議罷督府，力請講和，大寶奏謂：「今國事莫大于恢復，莫仇于金敵，莫難於攻守，莫審於用人。

translations.literal: Not long after, Tang Situi proposed abolishing the command headquarters and strongly sought peace; Dabao memorialized: "Of state affairs none is greater than recovery, none more hated than the Jin foe, none harder than attack and defense, none more critical than employing men.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after, Tang Situi proposed abolishing the command headquarters and strongly sought peace; Dabao memorialized, "Of state affairs none is greater than recovery, none more hated than the Jin foe, none harder than attack and defense, none more critical than employing men.

sentences.zh: 宰相以財計乏，軍儲虛，符離師潰，名額不除，意在覈軍籍，減月給。

translations.literal: The chief councillor, citing exhausted finances and empty granaries, Fuli's rout, and uncleared roster names, intends to audit army registers and cut monthly pay.
translations.idiomatic: The chief councillor, citing exhausted finances and empty granaries, Fuli's rout, and uncleared roster names, intends to audit army registers and cut monthly pay.

sentences.zh: 臣恐不惟邊鄙之憂，而患起蕭牆矣。」

translations.literal: I fear not only frontier worry but trouble arising within the palace walls."
translations.idiomatic: I fear not only frontier worry but trouble arising within the palace walls."

sentences.zh: 章三上，除兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted three times; he was appointed vice minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted three times; he was appointed vice minister of War.

sentences.zh: 胡銓為起居郎，奏曰：「近日王十朋、王大寶相繼引去，非國之福。」

translations.literal: Hu Quan as recorder of the emperor memorialized: "Recently Wang Shipeng and Wang Dabao left in succession — this is not the state's blessing."
translations.idiomatic: Hu Quan as recorder of the emperor memorialized, "Recently Wang Shipeng and Wang Dabao left in succession — this is not the state's blessing."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「十朋力自引去，朕留之不能得。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Shipeng strongly removed himself; I kept him but could not.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Shipeng strongly removed himself; I kept him but could not.

sentences.zh: 大寶論湯思退太早，令為兵部侍郎，豈容復聽其去。」

translations.literal: Dabao criticized Tang Situi too early; now made vice minister of War — how can we again let him leave?"
translations.idiomatic: Dabao criticized Tang Situi too early; now made vice minister of War — how can we again let him leave?"

sentences.zh: 未幾，以敷文閣直學士提舉太平興國宮。

translations.literal: Not long after, he was appointed academician of the Filled Writings Hall to oversee Taiping Xingguo Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after, he was appointed academician of the Filled Writings Hall to oversee Taiping Xingguo Palace.

sentences.zh: 他日，銓奏事，上復諭之曰：「大寶留之經筵，亦固求去，勢不兩立。」

translations.literal: Another day Quan reported affairs; the emperor again told him: "Keeping Dabao at the classics lecture — he too firmly sought to leave; the two could not stand together."
translations.idiomatic: Another day Quan reported affairs; the emperor again told him, "Keeping Dabao at the classics lecture — he too firmly sought to leave; the two could not stand together."

sentences.zh: 銓奏：「自古臺諫論宰相多矣，若謂勢不兩立，則論宰相者皆當去。」

translations.literal: Quan memorialized: "From antiquity remonstrance officials criticized chief councillors often — if incompatible then critics should all leave."
translations.idiomatic: Quan memorialized, "From antiquity remonstrance officials criticized chief councillors often — if incompatible then critics should all leave."

sentences.zh: 大寶尋請致仕。

translations.literal: Dabao soon requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: Dabao soon requested retirement.

sentences.zh: 督府既罷，撤邊防，棄四州，金復犯邊，詔思退都督軍馬，辭不行。

translations.literal: After the command headquarters was abolished, border defense was withdrawn and four prefectures abandoned — the Jin again raided; an edict made Situi commander of armies — he declined.
translations.idiomatic: After the command headquarters was abolished, border defense was withdrawn and four prefectures abandoned — the Jin again raided; an edict made Situi commander of armies — he declined.

sentences.zh: 上震怒，竄思退，中外以大寶前言不用為恨。

translations.literal: The emperor was shaken with rage and banished Situi; court and country regretted that Dabao's earlier words were not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was shaken with rage and banished Situi; court and country regretted that Dabao's earlier words were not heeded.

sentences.zh: 乾道元年，落致仕，召為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: First year of Qiandao — retirement revoked, summoned as minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: First year of Qiandao — retirement revoked, summoned as minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 入對，言理財之道，當務本抑末。

translations.literal: In audience he spoke on fiscal management — should promote the root and restrain the branch.
translations.idiomatic: In audience he spoke on fiscal management — should promote the root and restrain the branch.

sentences.zh: 右正言程叔達奏大寶乞復免行錢非是，以舊職提舉太平興國宮。

translations.literal: Right remonstrance Cheng Shuda memorialized that Dabao's request to restore exemption transit fees was wrong — restored to old post overseeing Taiping Xingguo Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Right remonstrance Cheng Shuda memorialized that Dabao's request to restore exemption transit fees was wrong — restored to old post overseeing Taiping Xingguo Palace.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人閻安中欲留其行，叔達並劾之。

translations.literal: Drafting companion Yan Anzhong wished to keep him from going — Shuda impeached both.
translations.idiomatic: Drafting companion Yan Anzhong wished to keep him from going — Shuda impeached both.

sentences.zh: 詔大寶致仕。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Dabao to retire.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Dabao to retire.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，年七十七。

translations.literal: Soon he died, age seventy-seven.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he died, age seventy-seven.

sentences.zh: 金安節

translations.literal: Jin Anjie
translations.idiomatic: Jin Anjie

sentences.zh: 金安節，字彥亨，歙州休寧人。

translations.literal: Jin Anjie, styled Yanheng, was a man of Xiuning in She prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Anjie, courtesy name Yanheng, was a native of Xiuning in She prefecture.

sentences.zh: 資穎悟，日記千言，博洽經史，尤精于《易》。

translations.literal: Naturally clever — he memorized a thousand words daily, was broadly versed in classics and histories, and especially skilled in the Changes.
translations.idiomatic: Naturally clever — he memorized a thousand words daily, was broadly versed in classics and histories, and especially skilled in the Changes.

sentences.zh: 宣和六年，由太學擢進士第，調洪州新建縣主簿。

translations.literal: Sixth year of Xuanhe — selected in the jinshi from the Directorate, appointed recorder of Xinjian county in Hong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth year of Xuanhe — selected in the jinshi from the Directorate, appointed recorder of Xinjian county in Hong prefecture.

sentences.zh: 紹興初，范宗尹引為刪定官。

translations.literal: Early Shaoxing — Fan Zongyin brought him in as revision officer.
translations.idiomatic: Early Shaoxing — Fan Zongyin brought him in as revision officer.

sentences.zh: 入對，言：「司馬光以財用乏，請用宰相領總計使，宜以為法。」

translations.literal: In audience he said: "Sima Guang, finding finances exhausted, asked that the chief councillor head the fiscal commissioner — this should be the model."
translations.idiomatic: In audience he said, "Sima Guang, finding finances exhausted, asked that the chief councillor head the fiscal commissioner — this should be the model."

sentences.zh: 除司農丞，又遷殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: Appointed vice director of the granaries bureau, then moved to attendant censor.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed vice director of the granaries bureau, then moved to attendant censor.

sentences.zh: 韓世忠子彥直直秘閣，安節言：「崇、觀以來，因父兄秉政而得貼職近制，皆在討論。

translations.literal: Han Shizhong's son Yanzhi was given direct appointment to the Secretariat — Anjie said: "Since Chongning and Daguan, those who got near posts through fathers and brothers in power are all under discussion.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shizhong's son Yanzhi was given direct appointment to the Secretariat — Anjie said, "Since Chongning and Daguan, those who got near posts through fathers and brothers in power are all under discussion.

sentences.zh: 今彥直復因父任而授，是自廢法也。」

translations.literal: Now Yanzhi again receives appointment through his father — this is self-abolishing the law."
translations.idiomatic: Now Yanzhi again receives appointment through his father — this is self-abolishing the law."

sentences.zh: 不報。

translations.literal: No reply.
translations.idiomatic: No reply.

sentences.zh: 任申先除待制致仕，安節劾其忿戾，乞追奪。

translations.literal: Ren Shenxian was granted ceremonial retirement — Anjie impeached his harsh temper and begged reversal.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Shenxian was granted ceremonial retirement — Anjie impeached his harsh temper and begged reversal.

sentences.zh: 秦檜兄梓知台州，安節劾其附麗梁師成，梓遂罷，檜銜之。

translations.literal: Qin Hui's brother Zi was prefect of Taizhou — Anjie impeached him for clinging to Liang Shicheng; Zi was dismissed and Hui bore a grudge.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Hui's brother Zi was prefect of Taizhou — Anjie impeached him for clinging to Liang Shicheng; Zi was dismissed and Hui bore a grudge.

sentences.zh: 未幾，丁母憂去，遂不出。

translations.literal: Not long after he left on mourning for his mother and did not return.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after he left on mourning for his mother and did not return to office.

sentences.zh: 檜死，起知嚴州，除浙西提刑。

translations.literal: After Hui died he was raised as prefect of Yanzhou and appointed judicial intendant of western Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: After Hui died he was raised as prefect of Yanzhou and appointed judicial intendant of western Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 入為大理卿，首言：「治民之道，先德後刑，今守令慮不及遠，簿書期會，賦稅輸納，窮日力辦之，而無卓然以教化為務者。

translations.literal: He entered as chief of the Court of Judicial Review; first said: "The way to govern the people puts virtue before punishment — now magistrates fear not thinking far; documents and deadlines, tax delivery — they exhaust the day on these without standing out to make transformation their task.
translations.idiomatic: He entered as chief of the Court of Judicial Review; first said, "The way to govern the people puts virtue before punishment — now magistrates fear not thinking far; documents and deadlines, tax delivery — they exhaust the day on these without standing out to make transformation their task.

sentences.zh: 願申飭守令，俾無專事法律，苟可以贊教化，必力行之。」

translations.literal: I beg to admonish magistrates not to specialize in law alone — if anything can aid transformation they must strive to do it."
translations.idiomatic: I beg to admonish magistrates not to specialize in law alone — if anything can aid transformation they must strive to do it."

sentences.zh: 時獲偽造鹽引者，大臣欲置之死，安節力爭，以為事已十餘年，且自首無死法，因得減等。

translations.literal: When counterfeit salt tallies were captured, ministers wished death — Anjie argued forcefully: the matter was over ten years old and self-surrender carried no death penalty — the sentence was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: When counterfeit salt tallies were captured, ministers wished death — Anjie argued forcefully: the matter was over ten years old and self-surrender carried no death penalty — the sentence was reduced.

sentences.zh: 兩浙漕屬王悅道鞫仁和令楊績獄不實，事下大理，安節並逮悅道。

translations.literal: Wang Yuedao of the two Zhe transport bureau tried the case of Yang Ji, magistrate of Renhe, as untrue — the matter went to the Court of Review; Anjie also arrested Yuedao.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yuedao of the two Zhe transport bureau tried the case of Yang Ji, magistrate of Renhe, as untrue — the matter went to the Court of Review; Anjie also arrested Yuedao.

sentences.zh: 悅道，幸醫王繼先子也，屢因人求免，安節不從。

translations.literal: Yuedao was the son of the favored physician Wang Jixian; repeatedly through others he begged release — Anjie did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: Yuedao was the son of the imperial favorite Wang Jixian, the court physician; he repeatedly had others intercede for his release, but Anjie refused.

sentences.zh: 遷宗正少卿。

translations.literal: He was transferred to vice director of the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice director of the Imperial Clan Court.

sentences.zh: 為金使施宜生賀正，安節館伴。

translations.literal: When the Jin envoy Shi Yisheng came to offer New Year's felicitations, Anjie served as host commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin envoy Shi Yisheng arrived to offer New Year's greetings, Anjie served as his host commissioner.

sentences.zh: 屬顯仁皇后喪，服黑帶，宜生曰：「使人以賀禮來，迓使安得服黑帶？」

translations.literal: It happened to be mourning for Empress Xianren; he wore a black belt. Yisheng said: "The envoy comes with felicitation rites — how can the receiving commissioner wear a black belt?"
translations.idiomatic: It coincided with mourning for Empress Xianren, so he wore a black mourning belt. Yisheng said, "Your envoy has come with congratulatory rites — how can the commissioner who receives him wear a black belt?"

sentences.zh: 安節辭難再四，宜生屈服。

translations.literal: Anjie pleaded difficulty again and again; Yisheng yielded.
translations.idiomatic: Anjie raised objections again and again until Yisheng backed down.

sentences.zh: 遷禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to vice minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 明年，再充送伴使。

translations.literal: The next year he again served as escort commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he again served as escort commissioner.

sentences.zh: 至楚州，副使耶律翼奪巡檢王松馬不得，鞭笞之。

translations.literal: At Chuzhou, the deputy envoy Yelü Yi could not seize the horse of the patrol officer Wang Song and had him flogged.
translations.idiomatic: At Chuzhou the deputy envoy Yelü Yi tried to seize patrol officer Wang Song's horse and, failing, had him flogged.

sentences.zh: 安節遣人責翼，詞色俱厲，朝廷恐生事，坐削兩秩。

translations.literal: Anjie sent someone to rebuke Yi — words and manner both fierce — the court feared trouble and demoted him two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Anjie sent a man to rebuke Yi in words and tone both stern; the court, fearing an incident, punished him by stripping two ranks.

sentences.zh: 葉義問使金，金主因言：「前日奪馬事，曲在翼，已笞二百，回日可詳奏。」

translations.literal: Ye Yiwen went as envoy to Jin; the Jin ruler thereupon said: "In the horse seizure the other day, the fault was on Yi's side; he has already been flogged two hundred strokes — on your return you may report this in detail."
translations.idiomatic: When Ye Yiwen went as envoy to Jin, the Jin ruler remarked, "In the recent horse incident the wrong lay with Yi; he has already been flogged two hundred times. When you return, you may report this in full."

sentences.zh: 乃復元官。

translations.literal: His original rank was then restored.
translations.idiomatic: His former rank was then restored.

sentences.zh: 遷禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to vice minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was again promoted to vice minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 將祠明堂，時已聞欽宗升遐，安節言：「宮廟行禮，皆當以大臣攝事。」

translations.literal: When about to sacrifice at the Bright Hall, word had already come that Emperor Qinzong had passed; Anjie said: "Palace and temple rites all ought to be carried out by ministers acting in proxy."
translations.idiomatic: As preparations were made to sacrifice at the Bright Hall, news had already arrived that Emperor Qinzong had died. Anjie said, "Rites at the palace and ancestral temples should all be performed by senior ministers acting in the emperor's stead."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted his advice.

sentences.zh: 遷侍講、給事中。

translations.literal: He was transferred to court lecturer and supervising secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to court lecturer and supervising secretary.

sentences.zh: 殿院杜莘老論張去為補外，安節言：「不可因內侍而去言官。」

translations.literal: Censor Du Xinlao memorialized that Zhang Quwei be sent out on provincial assignment; Anjie said: "One must not remove a remonstrating official because of inner attendants."
translations.idiomatic: Censor Du Xinlao argued that Zhang Quwei should be posted outside the capital; Anjie said, "A remonstrating official must not be removed because of pressure from inner attendants."

sentences.zh: 上遂留莘老。

translations.literal: The emperor then kept Xinlao.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then kept Xinlao at his post.

sentences.zh: 金主亮犯淮，從幸建康。

translations.literal: When the Jin ruler Wanyan Liang invaded the Huai, he accompanied the emperor to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin ruler Wanyan Liang invaded the Huai region, Anjie accompanied the emperor to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 亮死，安節陳進取、招納、備守三策，而以備守為進取、招納之本。

translations.literal: When Liang died, Anjie set forth three policies — advance, recruit, and defend — holding that defense was the foundation of advance and recruitment.
translations.idiomatic: After Liang's death, Anjie presented three strategies — offensive action, recruitment, and defense — arguing that defense was the foundation of both advance and recruitment.
