translations.idiomatic: Whatever talent could be used he brought into his staff, employing their strengths without fussing over small faults; the outstanding he recommended by open memorial, and many rose to prominence at court, some reaching the two chief councils.

sentences.zh: 召對，除權吏部尚書，拜參知政事。

translations.literal: Summoned to audience, he was made acting minister of Personnel and Vice Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned to audience, he was made acting minister of Personnel and Vice Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 兩月，為言者所論，奉祠。

translations.literal: After two months he was impeached by remonstrance officials and given a temple sinecure.
translations.idiomatic: After two months he was impeached by remonstrance officials and given a temple sinecure.

sentences.zh: 起知明州，奏罷海物之獻。

translations.literal: He was raised as prefect of Mingzhou and memorialized to abolish the tribute of seafood.
translations.idiomatic: He was raised as prefect of Mingzhou and memorialized to abolish the tribute of seafood.

sentences.zh: 除端明殿學士，尋帥金陵。

translations.literal: Appointed academician of the Duanming Hall; soon after he commanded Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed academician of the Duanming Hall; soon after he commanded Jinling.

sentences.zh: 會歲旱，奏移軍儲米二十萬振饑民，減租米五萬。

translations.literal: When drought came he memorialized to shift two hundred thousand bushels of army grain to relieve the hungry and reduced rent grain by fifty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: When drought came he memorialized to shift two hundred thousand bushels of army grain to relieve the hungry and reduced rent grain by fifty thousand.

sentences.zh: 水賊徐五竊發，號「靜江大將軍」，捕而戮之。

translations.literal: The river bandit Xu Wu rose in rebellion, styling himself Great General of Jingjiang — he was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: The river bandit Xu Wu rose in rebellion, styling himself Great General of Jingjiang — he was captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 以病請閑，進資政殿學士，再領洞霄宮。

translations.literal: He requested leisure on grounds of illness, was advanced to academician of the Zizheng Hall, and again oversaw the Cave of Heaven abbey.
translations.idiomatic: He requested leisure on grounds of illness, was advanced to academician of the Zizheng Hall, and again oversaw the Cave of Heaven abbey.

sentences.zh: 紹熙三年，加大學士。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shaoxi he was made Grand Academician.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Shaoxi he was made Grand Academician.

sentences.zh: 四年薨。

translations.literal: He died in the fourth year.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fourth year.

sentences.zh: 成大素有文名，尤工於詩。

translations.literal: Chengda had long been famed for his writing, and was especially skilled in poetry.
translations.idiomatic: Chengda had long been famed for his writing, and was especially skilled in poetry.

sentences.zh: 上嘗命陳俊卿擇文士掌內制，俊卿以成大及張震對。

translations.literal: The emperor once ordered Chen Junqing to select literary men to manage inner drafting; Junqing named Chengda and Zhang Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor once ordered Chen Junqing to select literary men to manage inner drafting; Junqing named Chengda and Zhang Zhen.

sentences.zh: 自號「石湖」，有《石湖集》、《攬轡錄》、《桂海虞衡集》行於世。

translations.literal: He styled himself Stone Lake; his Stone Lake Collection, Record of Holding the Reins, and Collection of the Cassia Sea and Yuheng circulate in the world.
translations.idiomatic: He styled himself Stone Lake; his Stone Lake Collection, Record of Holding the Reins, and Collection of the Cassia Sea and Yuheng circulate in the world.

sentences.zh: 論曰：劉珙忠義世家，迨屬纊，以未雪讐恥為深恨。

translations.literal: The commentators say: Liu Gong came from a loyal and righteous house; on his deathbed his deep regret was that the national shame had not been avenged.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators say: Liu Gong came from a loyal and righteous house; on his deathbed his deep regret was that the national shame had not been avenged.

sentences.zh: 王藺犯顏忠諫，剛腸嫉惡。

translations.literal: Wang Lin offended the throne with loyal remonstrance — a firm will that hated evil.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lin offended the throne with loyal remonstrance — a firm will that hated evil.

sentences.zh: 方趙鼎、張浚非罪遠謫，朋交絕蹤，大寶獨從之遊，逮斥權姦，了無顧忌。

translations.literal: When Zhao Ding and Zhang Jun were banished without cause to distant places and friends cut off all contact, Dabao alone kept company with them; when he denounced powerful villains he showed not the slightest fear.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Ding and Zhang Jun were banished without cause to distant places and friends cut off all contact, Dabao alone kept company with them; when he denounced powerful villains he showed not the slightest fear.

sentences.zh: 安節拒秦檜，排淵、覿，堅如金石，孤立無黨，死生禍福，曾不一動其心。

translations.literal: Anjie resisted Qin Hui, drove out Long Dayuan and Zeng Di, stood firm as metal and stone, stood alone without faction — life, death, fortune, and disaster never once moved his heart.
translations.idiomatic: Anjie resisted Qin Hui, drove out Long and Di, stood firm as metal and stone, stood alone without faction — life, death, fortune, and disaster never once moved his heart.

sentences.zh: 當金兵犯大散關，剛中單騎星馳，夜起吳璘，一戰卻敵。

translations.literal: When Jin troops raided Dasan Pass, Gangzhong rode alone through the night, roused Wu Lin from his tent, and in one battle drove the enemy back.
translations.idiomatic: When Jin troops raided Dasan Pass, Gangzhong rode alone through the night, roused Wu Lin from his tent, and in one battle drove the enemy back.

sentences.zh: 成大致書北庭，幾於見殺，卒不辱命。

translations.literal: Chengda presented his memorial in the northern court and nearly lost his life, yet in the end did not disgrace his commission.
translations.idiomatic: Chengda presented his memorial in the northern court and nearly lost his life, yet in the end did not disgrace his commission.

sentences.zh: 俱有古大臣風烈，孔子所謂「歲寒然後知松柏之後凋」者歟？

translations.literal: All had the fierce integrity of great ministers of old — are they not those of whom Confucius said, "Only when the year grows cold do we know that the pine and cypress are the last to wither"?
translations.idiomatic: All had the fierce integrity of great ministers of old — are they not those of whom Confucius said, "Only when the year grows cold do we know that the pine and cypress are the last to wither"?

sentences.zh: 若祖舜奪楊愿恩，褫秦熺秩，誅檜惡於既死，彥穎論事激烈，披露忠藎，直氣亦可尚已。

translations.literal: As for Zushun's seizing Yang Yuan's favor, stripping Qin Xi of rank, and punishing Qin's evil after death; Yanying's fierce remonstrances and disclosure of loyal devotion — his upright spirit too is worthy of respect.
translations.idiomatic: As for Zushun's seizing Yang Yuan's favor, stripping Qin Xi of rank, and punishing Qin's evil after death; Yanying's fierce remonstrances and disclosure of loyal devotion — his upright spirit too is worthy of respect.
